# Dockio

Dockio Technosolutions Private Limited is an independent enterprise AI implementation partner.

## Who we help
Enterprise business and operations sponsors, AI and technology leaders, and consulting or technology partners seeking focused delivery capacity.

## Services
- Paid discovery and adoption planning: workflow selection, business outcomes, source access, permissions, review responsibilities, and implementation scope.
- Scoped delivery: ChatGPT adoption, AI workflows and agents, integration, and Codex-assisted implementation where appropriate.
- Ongoing support and improvement: workflow reviews, evaluations, documentation, and agreed maintenance.
- Partner co-delivery with explicit ownership and acceptance criteria.

## Engagement path
Introductory conversation -> agreed paid discovery or implementation scope -> controlled delivery -> ongoing improvement where needed.

Workflow examples on the site are illustrative patterns, not named customer case studies or promised results. Dockio is independent; no official OpenAI partnership or certification is claimed.
